texts.preamble: Urban Roots vs The Commissioner on 23 January, 2020 Author: S G Pandit Bench: S.G. Pandit In The High Court Of Karnataka, Dharwad Bench Dated This The 23Rd Day Of January, 2020 Before The Hon'Ble Mr.Justice S.G. Pandit Writ Petition No.111970/2020 (Lb-Res) Between: Urban Roots Hosur, Unkal Road, Maryamman Timasagar Colony, Vidyanagar, Hubballi, Rep. By Its Partner Narendra S/O. Sunil Tikandar Age : 28 Years, Occ : Business, R/O : Teachers Colony, Bengeri Extension, Hubballi, Tq : Hubballi, Dist : Dharwad. ... Petitioner (By Sri. Aravind D Kulkarni, Advocate) And 1. The Commissioner Hubli Dharwad Municipal Corporation Lamington Road, Hubballi. 2. The Health Officer Hdmc, Hubli, Dist : Dharwad. 3. The Designated Officer, Food, Safety And Standards Department, Hubballi, ... Respondents (By Sri. G I Gachchinamath, Advocate For R1-R3) This Writ Petition Is Filed Under Articles 226 And 227 Of The Constitution Of India Praying To Issue Writ 2 Urban Roots vs The Commissioner on 23 January, 2020 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/44251959/ 1 Of Mandamus Or Any Other Writ Of Directing To The Respondents To Remove The Seal And Lock Put To The Shop/Property Namely Urban Roots Hosur, Unkial Road, Maryamman Timmasagar Colony Vidyanagar, Hubballi. This Writ Petition Coming On For Preliminary Hearing This Day, The Court Made The Following: Order
texts.facts: The petitioner is before this Court under Article 227 of the Constitution of India praying for a writ of mandamus directing the respondents to remove the seal and lock put to the shop/property namely "Urban Roots", Hosur, Unkal Road, Hubballi. 2. The petitioner which is a partnership firm claims that it is a license holder for running Restaurant in Hubballi. The said license is in force from 16.8.2019 to 15.08.2020. The petitioner is lawfully running the business of vegetarian restaurant and cafe in the address stated above. On 25.12.2019, the respondents officials without any authority conducted the raid on the restaurant and locked the premises and sealed the same without following any due process of law.
texts.arguments: 4. Today, Sri. G.I. Gachchinamath, learned counsel for respondents 1 to 3 on instruction from the respondents submits that the petitioner-restaurant was raided and lock was put as the petitioner-Restaurant was unauthorisedly offering Hookah to their customers. He further submits that the application for Trade License is pending and the petitioner has paid requisite fee towards consideration of the said application.
